paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Comparison of the Improvement for 5-digit and 6-digit multiplication with as feedback model

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates accuracy improvement over iterations for two different digit configurations. The x-axis represents "Iteration", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 9, and tick labels appearing at each integer value. The y-axis represents "Accuracy (%)" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick labels at 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, and 100. A blue line with circular markers denotes the 6-digit results, displaying an initial accuracy of 0% at iteration 0, rising sharply to approximately 65% by iteration 2, and then continuing to increase steadily, reaching around 95% by iteration 9. An orange line with square markers represents the 5-digit results, beginning at 0% accuracy and also exhibiting a rapid increase to 80% by iteration 2, then showing a gradual upward trend to finish at approximately 90% at iteration 9. Both lines show a positive trend with differing rates of increase over the iterations and intersect each other at an x-value of 3. A legend is there at the top left of the line plot to match different lines to their labels.
